clips.title: The story
paras: In Search of the Excavation Team begins with Tarrel Rockweaver in the Wetlands, who is distraught over a sudden silence from his wife, Merrin. Assigned to the prestigious Whelgar Excavation Site to the east, she has missed two weeks of regular letters, prompting fears that disaster has struck the expedition. Travelers are tasked with venturing into the marsh to locate the dig site and ascertain her safety.

While stationed in the soggy expanse of the Wetlands, Tarrel Rockweaver anticipated steady correspondence from his wife Merrin. Operating out of the dwarven dig known as the Whelgar Excavation Site, Merrin had maintained weekly dispatches describing their work. When two full weeks passed without a single word, Tarrel grew convinced that calamity had overtaken the camp. With official dwarf authorities stretched thin, he relies on passing scouts to brave the perils of the marshes to see if the diggers still draw breath.

The Whelgar Excavation Site represents a typical dwarven endeavor to unearth ancient Titan relics and Titan-forged history buried in the muck of the Wetlands. However, digging into prehistoric strata in wild territory frequently exposes crews to untamed beasts and hostile subterranean threats. Reaching the site requires heading eastward into territory far removed from the relative safety of the main roads, where whatever disrupted the diggers' letters still lingers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You cannot imagine how worried I have been.

My wife, Merrin, has been sending me letters each week for the past month. She is part of the Whelgar Excavation team. But it has been nearly two weeks since her last correspondence. Surely something is wrong!
Longbraid said that he would send a scout to check up on things if we did not hear from the team soon. I assume that scout is you, friend. Find Merrin at the excavation site to the east!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, thank the heavens you are here!
